core_categories: Industrial Supplies; MRO Supplies; Power Tools; Safety Equipment; Electrical Items; Hand Tools
specialty_focus: Moglix is a B2B e-commerce platform specializing in industrial procurement and supply chain solutions for manufacturing, infrastructure, automotive, engineering, and construction sectors. It offers a wide range of industrial products including MRO supplies, power tools, safety equipment, and electrical items, with a focus on digitizing procurement and providing bulk sourcing and vendor management. Moglix does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Bosch, Eveready, Havells, V-Guard, Makita, Karam, HP, others
